## Summary

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, agent and branch.

## Migrations/data files

List migrations and data-file changes, or state `None`. For a dependent deployment, record authorized migration application and status first.

## Owner actions

List approvals, manual actions, or blocked credential/account/platform setup, or state `None`.

## Tests

List commands and results. Separate passed checks, pending CI and blocked checks. Never use live financial/provider APIs.

## Risks

List material risks and recovery considerations, or state `None`.

## Screenshots

Required for UI changes; include Arabic/mobile views where applicable. State `Not applicable` for non-UI changes.
